name: hdbt
description: Theme builder configuration for HDBT Drupal 10 theme
author: Druid
@comment scripts: Every script below runs inside a disposable Node container via the sandbox command.

scripts.build: sandbox sh -c 'npm run format:js --loglevel=silent && npm run lint -s && npm run validate-ts && node theme-builder.mjs'

@comment dependencies: The following packages were updated manually.
Remove this section once the dependencies have been updated in their respective upstream packages.

@comment dependencies.backstopjs > puppeteer: ^25.8.0, Backstop depends on a vulnerable version of puppeteer
@comment dependencies.postcss: ^8.5.23, dependency of hds-react; fixes path traversal via sourceMappingURL (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849)
@comment dependencies.postcss-selector-parser: ^7.1.6, dependency of postcss-nesting via hds-react; PostCSS: Quadratic complexity in flat selector parsing allows CPU exhaustion (GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf)
@comment dependencies.qs: ^6.16.0, dependency of express and body-parser via backstopjs; no fixed express 4.x or body-parser 1.x release exists (GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g)
@comment dependencies.@react-spring/* and react-popper: $react, dependencies of hds-react; stale react ^18 peer ranges, verified React 19 safe. Remove once hds-react ships @react-spring/web >=10
@comment dependencies.svg-sprite > glob: ^13.0.0, dependency of theme-builder; drops deprecated glob@7 and inflight
